<thought>To find all possible precursors, I apply retrosynthetic template 149040 to the target molecule (the product containing the silyl ether). The product SMILES without atom‑mapping is:
`CCOC(=O)CH2C1CC(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C(=C(C)C)O1`
Applying the template yields the two reactants that would form this product: the silyl reagent and the deprotected alcohol. The tool returns these precursors as a single combination.</thought>
<final_answer>[["O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C", "CCOC(=O)CH2C1CC(O)C(C)(C)C(=C(C)C)O1"]]</final_answer>
